# part of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/partOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

Universal part-to-whole relation: relates any GMEOW thing to a larger whole it is part of. Transitive and intentionally broad; use specialized subproperties such as [`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md), [`gmeow:subOrganizationOf`](gmeow-subOrganizationOf.md), [`gmeow:subEventOf`](gmeow-subEventOf.md), [`gmeow:partOfThread`](gmeow-partOfThread.md) or module-specific component properties when the kind of parthood matters. No domain/range is asserted so event, location, information-object and endurant parthood all remain possible in OWL 2 DL.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md) when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.

### Scope notes
